notes: The apodosis then is the waw of וחרה, which is written in the clause, so rule 14 places it rather than leaving it added.
In this verse the ASV writes unto for the final לְ, so it is aligned rather than left unrepresented as in vv.13 and 15.
בעברכם: the temporal בְּ takes When (rule 52), the suffix is the infinitive's subject and takes ye (rule 18), and the infinitive keeps transgress.
